findings: All four critical paths originate at Processor System Reset peripheral_aresetn and end at parallel vendor Ethernet Lite reset synchronizers, depth 2 or 4. They are reset-fanout warnings, not user payload crossings.
Two CDC-2 warnings concern two-stage carrier-sense and MDIO input synchronizers missing ASYNC_REG in vendor MAC.
CDC-15 warnings concern vendor XPM FIFO memory enables and MDM debug protocol crossings.
decision: Retain all warnings without adding user waivers. Scoped review supports volatile laboratory functional testing; no production CDC, reset-phase stress or MTBF qualification is claimed.
